name: Issachar
overview: Issachar, one of Jacob's sons, is introduced in Genesis as a gift from God to Leah, symbolizing a hired reward. Jacob's blessing portrays Issachar as a strong and burden-bearing servant who values rest and pleasant land. The tribe of Issachar is noted in the census during the wilderness journey, numbering over fifty-four thousand able-bodied men prepared for war, highlighting their military significance among Israel's tribes.
